intro: Safe moving and handling protects you and the people you support from serious harm, keeping everyone safe, comfortable and as independent as possible.
points: Never use banned lifts such as the drag lift; the Royal College of Nursing regards it as a form of abuse.
Work through the hierarchy — avoid, assess, reduce — and use TILE to assess every move before you act.
Only use equipment you are trained on; take faulty or out-of-test hoists out of use and report them.
Never try to catch a falling adult or manually lift someone from the floor; use a hoist instead.
Keep a stable base, bend your knees, hold the load close and never twist while holding weight.
This is awareness training only; complete practical training and be assessed as competent before you handle anyone for real.
